decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line release note [ev-9761b3519d5c]. It says a new pattern variable, %SERVICE_NAME%, was added "for stat prefix", but it doesn't name the configuration field or API that accepts that pattern, so the subject can't be pinned down. It also doesn't say what the variable expands to, whether any default stat prefix changed, or whether the variable is only used when an operator configures it, so the change and applicability can't be written from this text. We need the linked PR/issue (52177) or the docs for the affected stat-name/stat-prefix setting.
